lines.text: Iterations. An F1 race-car aerodynamics test.
lines.tts: Iterations. An F1 race-car aerodynamics test.

lines.text: It starts from a detailed F1 2026 concept car, straight from CAD.
lines.tts: It starts from a detailed F1 2026 concept car, straight from CAD.
lines.ko: 정교한 F1 2026 컨셉카, CAD 모델에서 바로 시작합니다.

lines.text: Ask in plain language. The AI assistant can set up the run and drive the studio.
lines.tts: Ask in plain language. The A.I. assistant can set up the run and drive the studio.
lines.ko:
평범한 말로 요청하면, AI 어시스턴트가
해석을 설정하고 스튜디오를 조작할 수 있습니다.

lines.text: It opens the car, brings in the mesh and the solution, and puts the results on screen.
lines.tts: It opens the car, brings in the mesh and the solution, and puts the results on screen.
lines.ko: 형상을 열고, 격자와 해석 결과를 불러와 화면에 띄웁니다.

lines.text: Our in-house mesh generator builds 3.2 million cells in about 32 minutes.
lines.tts: Our in-house mesh generator builds three point two million cells in about thirty-two minutes.
lines.ko: 자체 격자 생성기가 약 32분 만에 320만 셀을 만듭니다.

lines.text: Next, a single GPU, an RTX 5070 Ti, solves the flow at 250 km/h.
lines.tts: Next, a single G.P.U., an R T X fifty seventy T i, solves the flow at two hundred and fifty kilometres per hour.
lines.ko:
이어서 GPU 한 장, RTX 5070 Ti가
시속 250 km의 유동을 풉니다.

lines.text: Pressure, mapped across every surface of the car.
lines.tts: Pressure, mapped across every surface of the car.

lines.text: Streamlines trace the air over the front wing, the wheels and the rear wing.
lines.tts: Streamlines trace the air over the front wing, the wheels and the rear wing.
lines.ko: 유선이 앞날개, 바퀴, 뒷날개 위로 흐르는 공기를 따라갑니다.

lines.text: The centre plane shows the wake. From CAD to flow field, end to end.
lines.tts: The centre plane shows the wake. From CAD to flow field, end to end.
lines.ko:
중앙 단면이 후류를 보여줍니다.
CAD에서 유동장까지, 처음부터 끝까지.

lines.text: Set up by AI. Solved on the GPU.
lines.tts: Set up by A.I. Solved on the G.P.U.
